learning_outcomes.text: Explain the operation of networks in an integrated manner, identifying and implementing different solutions to support applications and services.
Explain, distinguish and evaluate different protocols and services available for end-to-end communication and communication between applications over the network.
Explain the architecture of the transport network, software defined networks and mobility. Be able to distinguish and evaluate different architectures.
Be able to distinguish different approaches and solutions for multimedia networks and multicast. Be able to distinguish and evaluate different existing techniques for them.
Configure different network architectures, identifying and implementing different solutions in an integrated manner. Detect and correct errors in their configuration.

syllabus_topics: Interconnection and routing in IP networks.
Software defined and configured networks: SDN architecture, OpenFlow, NFV.
Protocols definition in ABNF and ASN1.
Name services: DNS, etc.; Electronic mail; WWW Architecture.

assessment_methods.method: 1st written test on CP1 and CP2
2nd written test on CP3 to CP5
Written test on CP1 to CP5 (Season 1 Evaluation)
Written test on CP1 to CP5 (Season 2 Evaluation)
Written test on CP1 to CP5 (Special Season Evaluation)

assessment_rules: For evaluation during the semester, a minimum score of 8 out of 20 is required in the weighted rounded average of the written tests (30% + 35% of the final grade). A minimum score of 8 out of 20 is also required in the weighted rounded average of the laboratories (35% of the final grade). Evaluation for Season 1, Season 2, and Special Season is 100% based on a single written test covering all program contents.
